title: Applied Materials fiscal Q3 2026 results furnished on Form 8-K
excerpt: Fiscal Q3 revenue was USD 9.115 billion, GAAP operating margin was 33.7%, and operating cash flow was USD 3.037 billion.
summary: Applied reported record fiscal-Q3 revenue and margins, USD 14.501 billion of cash and investments against USD 6.544 billion of debt, and fiscal-Q4 non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of USD 4.02 plus or minus USD 0.20.
